artworks.title: The Peasants Avenge Themselves
artworks.description: The image displays a chaotic scene with a high horizon line featuring distant trees and a building, potentially a church. The style is detailed and expressive with fine brushstrokes capturing the liveliness of the scene. The color scheme is monochrome in black and sepia on a beige background. Figures in combat or fleeing are in the foreground, while further back, there are individuals on horseback and more activity within a wooded area. In the background, there are more trees and faint structures indicating a town or settlement.

artworks.title: Distribution of Rewards
artworks.description: This is a print of a military scene in a grand architectural setting. The scene depicts an elaborate ceremony or presentation in a large hall or courtyard surrounded by arches and columns. A central figure is seated on an elevated throne on the right, and surrounded by several standing individuals engaged with a large group of armed soldiers gathered in front of the throne. The soldiers appear to be assembled in a formal manner, holding banners, and clad in military attire of the period, including feathered caps and armor. The intricate cross-hatching technique used highlights the textures and shadows, adding depth to the scene. The text below the illustration in French suggests a didactic or moralizing element to the image.

artworks.title: The Assumption of the Virgin
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 28.7 x 19.7 cm (11 5/16 x 7 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image is a black-and-white engraving depicting a religious scene. In the upper portion, a woman is shown ascending amongst clouds, with her hands clasped in front of her. She has closed eyes and long flowing hair. Surrounding her are cherubs with wings. Below her, a group of figures are gathered, appearing to witness the scene. They have various expressions and hairstyles, and are dressed in draped clothing. The background consists of dense cloud formations.

artworks.title: The Descent of the Holy Spirit
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures gathered beneath a descending dove. The drawing features multiple figures clad in flowing robes, gathered closely in a circular composition. Above them, a dove with outstretched wings descends, emanating rays of light that surround it. The figures appear animated, with gestures and expressions that convey a sense of awe or contemplation, as they all face different directions, seemingly responding to the dove above. The background is architectural, suggesting an interior space with an arched structure. The intricate details and the shading give the drawing a dynamic and lively atmosphere.

artworks.title: The Descent of the Holy Spirit
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 18.7 x 17.6 cm (7 3/8 x 6 15/16 in.)

artworks.title: Beheading of Saint Catherine
artworks.description: The image portrays multiple figures and elaborate architecture in a detailed scene. There are figures in classical attire surrounded by arches and pillars. The characters exhibit dynamic poses and expressive faces. One central figure is on their knees, surrounded by standing figures. Some figures hold staffs or spears. The linework emphasizes the details of robes and architecture, creating a sense of drama and tension.

artworks.title: Battle of Nude Men
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battle scene involving horses and warriors. The composition is dense with action, as figures clash with each other. The background is a forested area, with large trees providing a textured backdrop. The energy of both humans and animals is captured in dynamic poses, with rearing horses and warriors engaged in combat. The etching technique creates an interplay of light and shadow, emphasizing the movement present in the scene.

artworks.title: Shepherds in a Landscape
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 13.3 x 25.5 cm (5 1/4 x 10 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image features three figures holding musical instruments in a lush foliage setting. The foliage is depicted with cross-hatching line work. In the background, there are hills, buildings, and mountains. The overall color palette is monochromatic with varied ink intensities.

artworks.title: The Virgin and Child with Saints
artworks.description: The image depicts several figures in a detailed engraving style. The central figure is a robed woman holding a child. The child has curly hair and is facing the viewer. To the left stands another figure in robes holding a staff, and to the right, a woman is kneeling. Two bearded men stand behind them, one reading a book aloud. All figures wear draped garments suggesting a historical or religious theme. A large tree with a dense canopy is in the background, along with the silhouette of a cross. In the bottom right corner, there is a signature that reads "Dominicus a Compagnola."

artworks.title: The Shepherd and the Old Warrior
artworks.description: The image depicts two full-body figures standing close to each other in an outdoor setting. The woman is leaning against a tree, facing slightly left with her head turned. She has long, wavy hair and wears a robe with loose, draping sleeves. The man stands behind her, also leaning on the tree with one arm, and has short hair with a long beard. He wears a patterned tunic with puffed sleeves and matching leg coverings. In the lower left corner, a dog lies at the base of the tree. The background shows a landscape with a building or structure in the distance, against rolling hills and a sky with horizontal lines suggesting clouds or wind. The scene is rendered in a detailed, sketch-like style.

artworks.title: Venus Reclining in a Landscape
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 9.6 x 13.4 cm (3 3/4 x 5 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a person reclining in a relaxed position outdoors. They are leaning back on a slope with their upper body elevated on fabric, legs extended and crossed at the ankles. The person has wavy shoulder-length hair, a serene expression, and delicate facial features. In the background, there are trees and foliage, with a village or settlement visible to the right. The inscription "DO. CAMP. 1517" is visible on the bottom left.

artworks.title: Lamentation of Christ
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to image): 28 x 18 cm (11 x 7 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a group of figures around a lifeless body. In the background, there are cross-like structures on a distant hill. The scene is highly detailed with intricate line work. The figures seem to be mourning the deceased figure in front of them. The foreground contains layered drapery and figures in different poses, suggesting a theme of grief and mourning. The background features a hilly landscape with three crosses. Various textures like trees and rocky landscapes add depth to the scene. A plaque in the bottom right reads "DOMINICVS CAMPAGNOLA 1517."

artworks.title: The Circumcision
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a ceremonial scene with a child and several figures dressed in robes. The image shows a detailed composition with the child involved in a ritual with adults surrounding them, holding the child and other objects. Architectural elements like arches and columns frame the scene, giving it an indoor atmosphere. The figures are intricately rendered with fine lines, highlighting their drapery and expressions, creating a solemn ambiance in the enclosed space.

artworks.title: Christ Stilling the Storm
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a boat in turbulent seas. The drawing depicts a small boat caught in a stormy sea with a group of figures onboard. The sea is illustrated with swirling lines representing waves. Above, the sky is filled with cloud formations, and there is a burst of light emanating from a cloud. The boat is detailed, showing oars and maritime elements. The figures inside the boat display varied expressions and gestures as they navigate through the storm. The background includes elements that suggest land, such as faint outlines of buildings or cliffs.

artworks.title: Christ Consoling the Centurion
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of individuals engaged in an interaction. The composition depicts a central figure with a halo reaching out to a kneeling individual on the ground. The kneeling person appears to be holding a cane and a bowl. Surrounding them are other individuals gesturing and observing the interaction with varied expressions. In the backdrop are natural elements like a tree and a distant landscape with hills. The figures and the environment are detailed with delicate lines and cross-hatching, indicative of an engraving or etching technique.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Magi
artworks.description: The image shows a circular illustration featuring a seated woman holding an infant on her lap. The woman wears a headscarf and a long robe, while the infant is shown unclothed. They are positioned on the left, with the woman facing three other figures on the right. The first figure is kneeling and holding out a dish toward the infant, dressed in a long robe with a head covering. The standing figure behind holds a lidded container and wears a turban-like headdress and layered garments. Beside them, the third figure holds a round object to their side and is dressed in a sleeveless tunic over a shirt with a head covering. The background shows architectural features, possibly a building with arched windows, and hints of vegetation above and behind the group. The art style appears to be a detailed etching or engraving.

artworks.title: Christ with Three of His Apostles
artworks.description: Multiple figures are depicted in full-length standing positions on the ground. In the center, two individuals are gesturing with their hands - one extending a hand towards the sky, while the other seems to be placing a hand on the first person's shoulder. These individuals have beards and are wearing long robes that drape to their feet, with their hair appearing wavy or curly. Three other people are surrounding these central figures, also wearing long robes and having varying hairstyles including short and curly. Above the group, in the clouds, there is a figure with a beard and long hair, holding one hand up and the other open. The foreground shows a rocky terrain, with a mountain landscape visible in the distant background, along with a few small buildings nestled at the mountain's base. Depth is created by the shading and natural features in the background.

artworks.title: Jesus Preaching in the Temple
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene in a classical architectural setting. The image features several figures draped in robes, gathered in a semi-circular arrangement. The central figure is positioned behind a podium or a lectern, illuminated with rays of light emanating from them. Surrounding this figure are other individuals, some holding books or scrolls, depicted in various thoughtful and engaged poses. The background showcases an architectural space with arches and columns. The intricate details emphasize the folds of the clothing and the expressive features of the figures. The drawing is executed with fine lines and shading, creating a sense of depth and texture.

artworks.title: The Triumph of Love
artworks.description: The image shows a mythological scene with various figures and classical architecture. There is a procession of figures, including those holding tridents and other items typical of mythology, with horses, and a winged figure wielding a bow and arrow. In the background, there is a hilly landscape featuring a staircase leading up to a temple or structure with columns. The scene is intricately detailed, showcasing flowing garments and dynamic postures of the figures, and the sky is filled with stylized clouds.

artworks.title: The Triumph of Chastity
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a classical scene with a procession involving mythical creatures and figures. It includes a pair of unicorns leading a chariot pulled by a figure holding a banner. Other figures in classical attire are participating in the procession, some carrying palms. On the right side is a circular temple with Corinthian columns and a dome. The background features a landscape with trees and distant architectural structures.

artworks.title: The Triumph of Fame
artworks.description: This is a detailed drawing of a procession featuring elephants and classical figures. The scene depicts a winged figure standing atop an elephant blowing a trumpet, with the elephants adorned with decorations. The backdrop includes columns, arches, and obelisks. The figures are dressed in classical Roman attire. The style is reminiscent of early engravings or etchings, focusing on detailed line work and shading.

artworks.title: The Triumph of Time
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an allegorical scene involving mythological and historical elements. The image depicts a winged figure riding on a chariot led by figures. Within the chariot are block-like elements, and in the background, there is a scene involving a building, trees, and a wheel structure. Deer are integrated into the scene. The visual allegory evokes themes of time, history, and the passage of events. The style mimics classical engravings with line work and shading that enhance the composition. The drawing includes a Latin inscription.

artworks.title: The Triumph of Eternity
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a celestial gathering. The image depicts a scene with divine figures and symbolic animals among clouds, with a cityscape below. The central figure stands with a banner, surrounded by other robed and seated figures. Various animals, including a lion and a lamb, are shown alongside celestial beings like angels holding trumpets or gesturing. In the background, clouds separate the heavenly assembly from the earthly cityscape at the bottom. The detailed figures convey movement and themes of divinity and judgement.
